data.description:
## Problem

`tests/conftest.py`'s `_no_repo_commits` guard fails a test whose checkout HEAD moved and ends
its message with an unconditional instruction:

    f"git repo. Undo the stray commit(s) with: git reset --hard {before[:10]}"

Like the REPO_ROOT leak guard next to it, this guard compares two snapshots of SHARED checkout
state and therefore cannot tell a test that committed from a concurrent `git commit` made by
another process in the same checkout. That second case is real and observed: the
`carryable-basalt-beagle` scope-correction comment records `Test moved the repo HEAD (<sha> ->
<sha>)` errors seen twice in one session from a concurrent commit, and `f0fb` established the
same shared-checkout condition for the leak guard.

Followed literally by someone whose HEAD moved because ANOTHER process committed, `git reset
--hard <sha>` discards that commit and every uncommitted change in the worktree. The guard is
handing out a destructive remedy for a cause it cannot confirm.

This is **wording, not behaviour** — the guard itself deletes nothing. It is filed separately
from `carryable-basalt-beagle` (which removed the leak guard's actual deletion) to keep that
change tight around its proven root cause.

## Prior art for the fix shape

`tests/_isolation.py:leak_failure_message` was corrected under `f0fb` (commit `c9a5388a83`) to
name both causes instead of asserting the one it cannot know, and
`tests/unit/test_external_mutation_diagnostics.py` pins that property. The same treatment
applies here: name the concurrent-commit possibility, and condition the `reset --hard` on the
reader having confirmed the commit is theirs.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The HEAD-move message no longer prescribes `git reset --hard` unconditionally; the
      destructive step is explicitly gated on the reader confirming the commit came from the
      test rather than from another process sharing the checkout.
- [ ] The message names the concurrent-external-commit possibility, mirroring
      `leak_failure_message`.
- [ ] A test pins both properties, alongside the existing ones in
      `tests/unit/test_external_mutation_diagnostics.py`.
- [ ] `make lint` and `make typecheck` pass.
data.title: HEAD-move guard prescribes an unconditional git reset --hard
